facts.value: EU applicants are considered in competition with Irish school leavers.
Offers cannot be issued until Round 1 offers after the Irish Leaving Certificate results are released.
Eligible applicants remain on the waiting list and may be offered in order of merit in later rounds, in accordance with CAO procedures.
The university does not issue conditional offers.
The definition of EU/Non-EU applicants is based on fee assessment criteria.
Applicants eligible for EU fees and applying for the first year of an undergraduate degree must apply via the Central Applications Office (CAO).
The CAO handbook gives details of application procedures and closing dates.
Applicants not eligible for EU fees and transfer applicants (post year 1) must apply directly to the University.
Detailed information regarding the recognised qualifications from each EU/EFTA/UK country can be found on the CAO website.

The document outlines the recognition of school leaving examinations for each EU/EFTA/UK country and includes details on the recognition of multi-national qualifications, such as the European Baccalaureate and the International Baccalaureate.
